text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The central committee of Mozambique's ruling Frelimo party has elected journalist Manuel Tome for a second term as general secretary, and replaced five of the 15 members of the party's powerful political commission. Three members of the commission are women.

- Non-governmental organisations in northeastern Tete province report an increase in car robberies, especially vehicles with foreign registration plates. Some of the thieves have obtained traffic police uniforms, enabling them to flag down cars before stealing them and fleeing to neighbouring Malawi.
